effect_description_eng:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[Your Turn] This Digimon without [Gotsumon] or [X Antibody] in its digivolution cards can't attack.
[Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an attack target is switched, you may unsuspend 1 of your Digimon with ＜Blocker＞.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] All of your Digimon with ＜Blocker＞ get +1000 DP.
